slots.label: Angles on a line and at a point
slots.labelAf: Hoeke op ’n lyn en by ’n punt

items.q: Two angles on a straight line are 65° and x. Find x.
items.qAf: Twee hoeke op ’n reguit lyn is 65° en x. Vind x.
items.explain: Angles on a straight line add up to 180°: x = 180° − 65° = 115°.
items.explainAf: Hoeke op ’n reguit lyn tel op tot 180°: x = 180° − 65° = 115°.

items.q: Angles around a point are 110°, 95° and y. Find y.
items.qAf: Hoeke om ’n punt is 110°, 95° en y. Vind y.
items.explain: Angles around a point add up to 360°: y = 360° − 110° − 95° = 155°.
items.explainAf: Hoeke om ’n punt tel op tot 360°: y = 360° − 110° − 95° = 155°.

items.q: Two vertically opposite angles are 3x and 72°. Find x.
items.qAf: Twee regoorstaande hoeke is 3x en 72°. Vind x.
items.explain: Vertically opposite angles are equal: 3x = 72°, so x = 24°.
items.explainAf: Regoorstaande hoeke is gelyk: 3x = 72°, dus x = 24°.

items.q: Lines AB and CD are parallel. A transversal makes a corresponding angle of 70°. What is the angle that corresponds to it on the other parallel line?
items.qAf: Lyne AB en CD is ewewydig. ’n Dwarslyn maak ’n ooreenkomstige hoek van 70°. Wat is die ooreenkomstige hoek op die ander ewewydige lyn?
items.explain: Corresponding angles between parallel lines are equal.
items.explainAf: Ooreenkomstige hoeke tussen ewewydige lyne is gelyk.

items.q: Alternate angles between parallel lines are (2x + 10)° and 80°. Find x.
items.qAf: Verwisselende hoeke tussen ewewydige lyne is (2x + 10)° en 80°. Vind x.
items.explain: Alternate angles are equal: 2x + 10 = 80, so 2x = 70 and x = 35.
items.explainAf: Verwisselende hoeke is gelyk: 2x + 10 = 80, dus 2x = 70 en x = 35.

items.q: Co-interior angles between parallel lines: one is 118°. What is the other?
items.qAf: Binnehoeke aan dieselfde kant tussen ewewydige lyne: een is 118°. Wat is die ander?
items.explainAf: Binnehoeke aan dieselfde kant tel op tot 180°: 180° − 118° = 62°.

items.q: Two angles that add up to 90°.
Two angles that add up to 180°.
The angles opposite each other when two lines cross.
items.qAf: Die hoeke teenoor mekaar wanneer twee lyne kruis.

items.q: A line that crosses two or more other lines.
items.qAf: ’n Lyn wat twee of meer ander lyne sny.

items.q: Alternate angles between parallel lines are equal.
items.qAf: Verwisselende hoeke tussen parallelle lyne is gelyk.
items.explain: True. They form a Z shape.

items.q: Two angles on a straight line are x and 3x. Find x.
items.qAf: Twee hoeke op ’n reguit lyn is x en 3x. Vind x.
